instrument_type_details.notes: Mesa had an active fuel hedging policy using heating oil contracts as proxies for jet fuel (SFAS 133 cash flow hedges). Hedging activity occurred in FY2003 with a $0.2M realized gain recognized in fuel expense. No fuel hedge derivative instruments were held at September 30, 2003 (no open positions at year-end). No hedging activity in FY2002 or FY2001. ~84% of fuel is pass-through under revenue-guarantee code-share agreements.
